overview.text: Punjab & Sind Bank, Zonal Office Bhopal invites sealed E-Tender proposals for Interior Furnishing, Electrical, Data Cabling, and Air Conditioning works at its new Model Branch in Tilhari Jabalpur. The tender is governed by the Bank's Integrity Pact (IP) policy, requiring bidders to sign a non-collusion agreement.

issuing_organization: Punjab & Sind Bank, Zonal Office Bhopal

scope.text: The scope includes Interior Furnishing, Electrical, Data Cabling, and Air Conditioning works for the PSB Tilhari Jabalpur Branch.
Contractors must furnish wooden partitions, paneling, false ceilings, and miscellaneous items, adhering to CPWD safety norms and approved brand specifications.
The contractor is responsible for supplying all material implements, scaffolding, temporary works, and ensuring workmanlike execution under Architect supervision.

key_requirements.text: Bidders must create a login ID/password on the E-Tender portal and submit sealed offers in English with audited financial statements for FY 2022-23 to 2024-25.
Bidders must possess minimum five satisfactory performance certificates and demonstrate past performance of similar works in MP/CG exceeding Rs. 13.95 Lakhs.
Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of Rs. 56,000/- is required (exempt for MSE/MSME), and a Bid Securing Declaration must be signed.

eligibility.text: Bidders must be eligible to do business in India, possess valid CMMI Level-3 or Level-5 certification (if applicable), and have executed minimum one similar work of Rs. 22.32 Lakhs.
Bidders must provide a written certificate confirming compliance with confidentiality requirements and declare no previous transgressions in the last three years.

important_dates.text: Bids must be valid for 03 months from submission; successful bidders must enter into the contract within 15 days of award.
Performance Security must be submitted within 7 days of receipt of Letter of Intent or Work Order.

commercial_requirements.text: Prices quoted must be in Indian Rupees, inclusive of all taxes and labor charges, with no claims for rate enhancement during the contract duration.
Services are billed on a Time & Material (T&M) basis; rates in words prevail over figures in case of discrepancy.

project_duration.text: Mobilization Period: 7 days from the date of Work Order.
Completion Period: 30 days from date of commencement.
['Time is the essence of the contract']
['The owner and contractor shall agree upon work progress chart indicating forecast dates; it may be amended by agreement within limitations imposed in the contract']

important_conditions.text: The tender is covered under the Integrity Pact (IP) policy; failure to sign the non-collusion agreement leads to disqualification.
Confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations apply; bidders must execute an NDA within one month of acceptance.
